free_tier.stated: free and open source under the Apache License 2.0; the agent works with any model behind the user's own key, and its docs name free API providers: 'OpenRouter offers free access to many models, with limitations on daily usage'
free_tier.notes: the agent costs nothing and imposes no quota; the endpoint it calls is the bill and the binding limit

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a coding agent meters nothing itself

egress.terms: not applicable: the chosen endpoint serves the inference

interface_detail: a terminal program. Headless: `aider --message` (`-m`) or `--message-file` runs one instruction, applies the edits and exits; `--yes` answers every confirmation; a Python API (`Coder.create`) exists but is documented as unsupported
tooling: the user installs and runs the aider CLI (pip `aider-install`, uv, pipx or the install script) on a rented or free machine, and points it at an endpoint with `--model` and `--api-key`; OpenAI-compatible endpoints, OpenRouter and GitHub Copilot's api.githubcopilot.com are documented
chaining: pairs with any endpoint in inference/ and with a GitHub Copilot subscription, whose calls through aider are billed to that subscription; the agent is free and the tokens are not
limits_note: no vendor-imposed usage cap: the vendor serves no inference, so the quota of the chosen endpoint binds
binding_note: the agent has no quota of its own; the endpoint's quota decides capacity

identity_cost.detail: no account is needed to run the agent, which installs from PyPI with 'python -m pip install aider-install'; each endpoint it calls carries its own identity cost

reliability_note: the latest PyPI release is 0.86.2, uploaded 2026-02-12; the release notes list further unreleased changes on the main branch
confidence_note: licence, install path, headless flags and the free-provider guidance are quoted from the project's own pages read on 2026-10-30. Capacity belongs to the endpoint chosen, so nothing about quota can be measured on the agent.
